name: Question 5
problem:
$$
{∬}_{D}\boxed{}\,\text{d}A,\,D={(x,z)\,:\,\boxed{}\,}
$$

The integral above gives the surface area of the part of the cone $y=4\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}$ that lies inside the cylinder ${x}^{2}+{z}^{2}=\frac{1}{4}.$ From left to right, what are the missing expressions?
worked_solution:
For a surface $S$ defined by $y=f(x,z)$ with $(x,z)\in D,$ the surface area of $S$ is given by

$$
{∬}_{S}\,\text{d}S={∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{(\frac{∂y}{∂x})}^{2}+{(\frac{∂y}{∂z})}^{2}}\,\text{d}A.
$$

In this case, our surface is given by

$$
y=4\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}},\,{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}\le \frac{1}{4}.
$$

Now, since

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂y}{∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(4\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}})=\frac{4x}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}}, \\ \frac{∂y}{∂z} & =\frac{∂}{∂z}(4\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}})=\frac{4z}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}},\end{aligned}
$$

the surface area is

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{S}\,\text{d}S & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{(\frac{∂y}{∂x})}^{2}+{(\frac{∂y}{∂z})}^{2}}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{(\frac{4x}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}})}^{2}+{(\frac{4z}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}})}^{2}}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+\frac{16{x}^{2}}{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}+\frac{16{z}^{2}}{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{\frac{17({x}^{2}+{z}^{2})}{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{17}\,\text{d}A.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is

$\,$ $\sqrt{17}\,$ and $\,{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}\le \frac{1}{4}.$

Question 5
?

∬DAAAdA,D={(x,z):AAAA}

The integral above gives the surface area of the part of the cone y=4x2+z2 that lies inside the cylinder x2+z2=14. From left to right, what are the missing expressions?

a
1+16x2+z2 and y≤2
b
17 and x2+z2≤14
c
1+16(x+y)x2+z2 and y≥2
d
4 and x2+z2=14
e
1+16x2+16y2 and x2+z2<4
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

For a surface S defined by y=f(x,z) with (x,z)∈D, the surface area of S is given by

∬SdS=∬D1+(∂y∂x)2+(∂y∂z)2dA.

In this case, our surface is given by

y=4x2+z2,x2+z2≤14.

Now, since

∂y∂x=∂∂x(4x2+z2)=4xx2+z2,∂y∂z=∂∂z(4x2+z2)=4zx2+z2,

the surface area is

∬SdS=∬D1+(∂y∂x)2+(∂y∂z)2dA=∬D1+(4xx2+z2)2+(4zx2+z2)2dA=∬D1+16x2x2+z2+16z2x2+z2dA=∬D17(x2+z2)x2+z2dA=∬D17dA.

Therefore, the correct answer is

17 and x2+z2≤14.
